prompt: Edit this simple cotton spinning diagram. Zoom OUT 30 percent so all fibers, arrow and spool are inside the central 70 percent with wide pale cream margins. Preserve many separately overlapping short fiber ends, merging by twist into one much longer continuous yarn at right on one spool. One curved blue arrow at twisting zone. Make the whole image clean flat 2D: solid cream fibers, crisp outlines, no grain or stippling, no 3D, no gradients. Do not change to weaving or add machines, people, shirt, text, panels, inset or frame. Landscape 3:2.

visualReview.note: Many short overlapping flattened cotton fibers twist into longer yarn on spool; corrected non-tubular fibers and safe margins.
